description: A React component named StatusSummary that displays a live, compact summary of card statuses ('To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done', 'On Hold') for a Kanban board. Uses context to fetch cards and their statuses, normalizes statuses, counts occurrences, and renders a status bar with counts.

methods.name: StatusSummary()
methods.description: React functional component that renders a status summary bar with counts of cards in each status category.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Helper function that normalizes various status strings into one of four buckets: 'todo', 'inprogress', 'done', 'hold'.
